summary: Iteration 6 - image upload, email-based password recovery, PIX auto-confirm webhook. Backend: 13/13 NEW tests in test_iteration6.py PASS: admin uploads 1x1 PNG → /api/public/images/{id} serves image/png 200; client POST→403; invalid base64→400; barber photo_url via PUT /barbers/{id} persists and client GET /barbers shows photo_url; service image_url via PUT /services/{id} persists and public /public/info includes image_url. Forgot-password: POST /auth/forgot (carlos@test.com) returns generic 200 message; GET /admin/password-resets returns record with email_sent boolean (false for @test.com — provider rejects fake domain, expected); reset via code succeeds; password restored to cliente123 (login verified). PIX auto-confirm: PUT /admin/pix-provider mercadopago returns webhook_secret + webhook_path and masks access_token as '***'; GET returns same; client books PIX appt with Wendel future Tuesday → payment_status aguardando_pagamento; txid = id.replace('-','')[:25]; wrong secret→401; correct webhook→200 with payment_status 'pago'; GET /appointments/{id}/payment-status as client→'pago'; audit log contains payment.webhook.paid for that appointment id; status 'pending' payload→200 ignored, payment_status unchanged; unknown txid→404; auto_confirm=false→200 ignored. Cross-user polling blocked (joao GET carlos's apt→403). Full regression: 84/88 pass + 3 skipped; the 4 failures are the SAME pre-existing shared-DB-state issues documented in iteration_5 (test_barbers PerBarberConflict / Mensal / test_security seed count). Frontend 390x844 verified: admin Barbeiros→Editar Wendel modal shows 'Foto do barbeiro' + testID barber-photo-pick + 'Enviar da galeria' button (screenshot /tmp/i6_barber_edit.png); Config→Serviços→Novo serviço form shows 'Imagem do serviço (opcional)' label with testID svc-image-pick + 'Enviar da galeria' (screenshot /tmp/i6_svc_new.png); Config→PIX scrolled shows 'Confirmação automática de PIX' card with ALL testIDs pix-provider-mercadopago, pix-provider-token, pix-provider-auto, pix-webhook-url (showing https://cortes-agendamentos.preview.emergentagent.com/api/webhooks/pix/mercadopago?secret=SFeNSyR_...), pix-provider-save → clicked save → success (provider persisted - verified via GET /admin/pix-provider returning mercadopago + secret) (/tmp/i6_pix_mp_selected.png + /tmp/i6_pix_saved.png); Forgot screen (/forgot) copy mentions e-mail: 'Enviaremos um código de 6 dígitos por e-mail (válido por 30 minutos). Verifique também o spam.' (screenshot /tmp/i6_forgot.png). pix-paid transition verified at BACKEND level end-to-end (webhook→payment-status→'pago'); frontend PixPayment component polls GET /appointments/{id}/payment-status every 5s and conditionally renders testID='pix-paid' with 'Pagamento confirmado!' when status=='pago' (code review /app/frontend/src/components/pix-payment.tsx:44-53). Full UI book→webhook→pix-paid timing in-browser not completed to end due to flaky multi-step booking selectors (date/slot scroll + barber picker races) and a transient 502 during run; however, each layer independently validated — see rca_of_issue. No deprecated expo packages (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch in frontend package.json).
action_items: Pre-existing (NOT caused by iter 6, same as iteration_5 action_items): test_barbers.py has 3 shared-DB-state failures (PerBarberConflict same-time, PerBarberConflict wendel_14 slot, Mensal carlos cycle exhausted); test_security.py::TestSeedProtection asserts len(services)==7 but DB has 11 due to accumulated TEST_svc_* archived entries. Fix out of scope — use uuid-based unique dates per test or filter TEST_ prefix.
(optional, nice-to-have) Add testIDs on agendar barber picker tiles (currently relies on 'Wendel' text search) to make end-to-end UI pix-booking tests more reliable.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_config.py /admin/images uses base64.b64decode(..., validate=True), 2MB cap, strict allowlist content types — solid.

/webhooks/pix/{provider} looks up appointment by txid=id.replace('-','')[:25] with fallback regex on first 8 chars; validates secret before any DB lookup (401 before 404), skips when auto_confirm=False, idempotent (if already pago no-op since paid_words still match but patch would be a no-op update + redundant audit entry — acceptable but could early-return when payment_status already 'pago').
payment_events collection records every webhook incl. ignored ones — good observability for debugging provider payloads.

email_service.py has strong G2/G3 safety assertions (no forms, no shorteners, no cred-asking phrases, https-only links, anchor-text matches real host). Falls back silently (returns None, logs error) so forgot-password still works via admin fallback — exactly as the PRD describes.
PixPayment polling runs every 5s and clears interval when status becomes 'pago' — correct effect-dependency array [apt?.id, status].
No deprecated expo packages detected in frontend/package.json (uses expo-image, expo-video not expo-av; no expo-barcode-scanner; no expo-background-fetch).
